name: sumo_cot_telemetry
title: SUMO bridge CoT telemetry table (carla-cot-telemetry --csv)
description: One row per vehicle per update of a SUMO run. The first line is the header. Comma separated, UTF-8. Its format version and what made it are in <name>.summary.json beside it. An empty cell is a value, the empty string, never a missing one.

fields.name: time_utc
fields.description: When the update happened, UTC to the millisecond: the run's epoch plus sim_time_s.

fields.name: sim_time_s
fields.description: SUMO simulation time, seconds.

fields.name: uid
fields.description: The track id: <uid prefix>-<SUMO vehicle id>. The uid prefix is SUMO-TRUTH unless --uid-prefix sets it.

fields.name: callsign
fields.description: <base_type>-<SUMO vehicle id>.

fields.name: cot_type
fields.description: The CoT type: a ground vehicle, with the affiliation the run's display convention gives the vehicle's population.

fields.name: how
fields.description: How the position was found: m-g, machine-generated truth.

fields.name: lat
fields.description: WGS84 latitude, degrees, of the front bumper's center.

fields.name: lon
fields.description: WGS84 longitude, degrees, of the front bumper's center.

fields.name: hae_m
fields.description: Bare-earth ground height under the vehicle, WGS84 ellipsoidal meters, from the world package's bareearth.bin; the configured constant when there is no grid or the vehicle is off it.

fields.name: ce_m
fields.description: Horizontal error, meters. Always 0.0 for truth.

fields.name: le_m
fields.description: Vertical error, meters. Always 0.0 for truth.

fields.name: course_deg
fields.description: The vehicle's heading as SUMO reports it, degrees clockwise from north.

fields.name: speed_mps
fields.description: Speed, meters per second.

fields.name: vx
fields.description: Velocity east, meters per second (CARLA's x).

fields.name: vy
fields.description: Velocity south, meters per second (CARLA's y).

fields.name: vz
fields.description: Vertical velocity. Always 0.00: SUMO is flat.

fields.name: base_type
fields.description: What kind of vehicle it is: the catalogue's cot_base_type for the blueprint the vehicle's type names, or its SUMO vehicle class's when the type names none.

fields.name: type_id
fields.description: The SUMO vehicle type id.

fields.name: special_type
fields.description: The catalogue's cot_special_type for the vehicle's blueprint: emergency, taxi, electric, or empty.

fields.name: length_m
fields.description: Length SUMO gives the vehicle, meters.

fields.name: width_m
fields.description: Width SUMO gives the vehicle, meters.

fields.name: height_m
fields.description: Height SUMO gives the vehicle, meters.

fields.name: color
fields.description: The vehicle type's sumo-gui color, R,G,B from 0 to 255. Not the color CARLA renders.

fields.name: role_name
fields.description: The flow the vehicle came from: its SUMO id before the last dot.

fields.name: marked
fields.description: 1 when the vehicle is one the scenario planted (--marked-vehicle or a legacy labels file's marked_ids), 0 otherwise.

fields.name: edge
fields.description: The SUMO edge the vehicle is on.

fields.name: lane
fields.description: The SUMO lane the vehicle is on.

fields.name: sumo_x
fields.description: SUMO x, meters east in the network's projection.

fields.name: sumo_y
fields.description: SUMO y, meters north in the network's projection.

fields.name: carla_x
fields.description: CARLA x, meters east: sumo_x.

fields.name: carla_y
fields.description: CARLA y, meters south: -sumo_y.
